title: Cache hit-rate monitoring
proves: Every registered cache is instrumented, the counters read back correct ratios, the Prometheus rules pass promtool check and tests, and in a real Prometheus every rule of the cache-hit-rate group evaluates (health=ok) on live API traffic with non-empty series.
doesNotProve: Any production hit rate, Alertmanager delivery, or counters on the web server and worker.
